name: rumour-and-denial-rumour-with-its-denial-intact

reports.context: Cedar United are reportedly in talks to sign Alex Stone, according to two unnamed sources. No agreement has been reached. Cedar United declined to comment.
reports.title: Cedar United update 1

review: Preserve the rumour qualification: reported, not agreed, and the club declined to comment.
A body that states a completed signing fails, even though the source names a player.
